bha:
Bha (ဘ) consonant —
Among the 41 letters of the Burmese alphabet, it is the 32nd letter.
Among the 33 consonants, it is the 28th.
Among the five consonant groups (vagga), it belongs to the labial group (produced at the lips, oṭṭhaja) and is the fifth letter of the Pa-vagga.
It is the fourth voiced consonant (dhanita-catutthakkhara) in its group.
(Reference: Tipiṭaka, Vol. 15, p. 361.)
